description: This file defines the interface for the IOcdmSystem class and its factory within the Rialto media server component. It includes class declarations, method signatures for managing DRM systems, and references to external session classes.

classes.name: IOcdmSystemFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IOcdmSystem instances.

classes.name: IOcdmSystem
classes.description: Interface for managing DRM system operations such as version retrieval, key store management, and session creation.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IOcdmSystemFactory instance.

methods.name: createOcdmSystem
methods.description: Creates an IOcdmSystem object for a specified key system.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version string of the DRM system.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Gets the limit on the number of LDL key sessions.

methods.name: deleteKeyStore
methods.description: Deletes the key store for the key system.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves a hash of the key store.

methods.name: getSecureStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves a hash of the secure store.

methods.name: getDrmTime
methods.description: Gets the current DRM system time.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new DRM session with a client callback.
